[[Brihan Chahu]] is an NPC found in [[Resplendent Makuun]] just outside the portal to [[Bokka Amphitheatre]]. He stands near the entrance to the hall where [[Prince Bokka the Magnificent]] can be found, often shouting orders. [[Katurin Ehmbolem]] can be found beside him.
